brief: Prioritise Yarrow Mill 230/34kV for pre-event attention because it is an ageing unit with a history of high loading, giving it a reduced margin against mechanical failure under thermal cycling [MG-023]. Where this unit cannot be attended before the heat event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023]. Note that for sustained events extending beyond 48 hours with overnight minima above 24 degrees, a further 5 percent reduction must be applied from the third day onward [MG-021], though the supplied documents do not cover the specific 17.76 degree overnight minimum noted for this asset.
